We need to determine SMILES of unknown compound given only description? No data provided. We have to use tools to get spectra etc. But we have no sample data. Perhaps the environment already has a sample "at hand". The tools like mass_spectrometry_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, carbon_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra will return data for the sample. We need to infer structure.

We should start by measuring mass spectrum to get molecular weight. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra.
